[b]Thanks and I hope you like the game![/b]

notes.title: My next game, Total World Liberation, wishlist now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177230/Total_World_Liberation/
[previewyoutube=08N85yARCMo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]They have taken over everything, it's up to you to LIBERATE the entire world![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/4799d3bd407cd877caa1969ba0b1351fd3a0482d.gif[/img]

* Find other [b]Survivors [/b]and bring them with you.
* [b]Build [/b]your base with a Workshop, Generator, Houses and plenty of [b]Defenses and Traps![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/dd7cbbeb3af23274fd65c6ead45e5f4904cf3f8b.gif[/img]

* Split up into [b]multiple teams[/b] and explore different areas, don't forget to bring [b]enough ammo[/b] when you leave your base!
* Set up outposts to [b]gather resources [/b]in far away lands and Transport them back to your base through[b] Automated machines,[/b] ensure the Zombies don't destroy your logistics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/c0c59f2340ef79f735d54daf64ea3e2d6674133c.gif[/img]

* [b]Craft items[/b], armor, weapons and lots of ammo, build [b]Drones[/b] to help you [b]Gather, Craft and Patrol[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/0603411db532e715ad234a9baeffaba910f22074.gif[/img]

* Explore a large [b]persistent open world[/b], with no loading or mission instances, everything happens in the world.
* Turn-Based so you can take your time to think and come up with the [b]perfect Strategy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/a141b0ffa70b7acb86963690902db36a487761f9.gif[/img]

* [b]Ambush[/b] Zombies and take them all out without suffering casualties
* Be careful when exploring at [b]night[/b], and be even more careful so you don't attract a [b]massive horde![/b]

Start just with [b]one[/b] Survivor and [b]Liberate the entire World![/b]


[h2]Add to your Wishlist now! Q3 2023[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/877249ba8ddffa0abe2dc4dca3ce1b5496e8c6a2.gif[/img]

[b]And follow the Development on YouTube @CodeMonkeyUnity[/b]



Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch this video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6DGDWfPdn3w

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #29
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZH12eaf.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

Another great new Developer Gauntlet in this week's update to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets[/b][/url] along with updated story Gauntlets based on Community feedback and several fixes.

[b]The Arena,[/b] Air Strikes, Sentry Guns, Crafting, Leveling. How many can you kill before you die?!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/GPUpv9S.jpg[/img]

Based on Community Feedback I have shortened the Gauntlets, Material Gathering and Base Building. They are now more tightly packed while still offering optional content.

If you have a slow internet connection, the whole game should be much more responsive right now thanks to several fixes on how the game communicates with the server.

Enjoy!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #27
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ByY0H5l.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

This week's update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets[/b][/url] adds some [b]visual feedback[/b] to Survivor movement indicating the path they will take and where they will aim when they get there. You can also change how long the pathing is visible in the options.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/37FUwws.jpg[/img]

Added Events for [b]Left/Right Mouse Button Down/Up,[/b] along with a way to store current Cursor position in a Variable. Using these new Actions you can make some very complex Gadgets or pick up items at the cursor position rather than with a Survivor or kill an Infected by clicking on him.

Replaced old Enable Disable Event_Actions for various Objects with a generic one. Also added a generic [b]Object.Move.[/b]

Next week's update will feature some interesting new Gauntlets and some Community Gauntlets so stay tuned!

Enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #23
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fC4xqPb.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

Yet another big update to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets,[/b][/url] [b]Editor Challenges[/b] have been added.
These are 20 Challenges of increasing complexity that you must use the Editor Event Actions to overcome. It should be a fun way of learning just how powerful the Editor can be.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZIpVmD2.jpg[/img]

Survivor Squad: Gauntlets is now available on [b]Mac and Linux![/b] So far I have kept only Windows builds due to the fact that it makes it faster to update every week but since V1.00 is around the corner this is the time to get Mac and Linux users involved!

You can now post [b]comments[/b] on the Featured Gauntlets, those comments will show in-game in the end screen, let everyone know what you thought.

[b]New Main Menu[/b] that guides new Players through all the Gauntlets ensuring a nice difficulty curve. Options Menu was also revamped and now all key bindings have the correct functions.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Sn0WBI8.jpg[/img]

Keep the feedback coming and enjoy the update!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #22
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4tr9vxH.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

Another massive update to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets![/b][/url]
Two more Developer Gauntlets added, these Gauntlets conclude the mini-campaign that starts with [b]Mike and Kenny[/b] and ends with [b]Routine Scavenging.[/b]

[b]Material Gathering, [/b]the Jeep is about to break down, search through this town and gather materials to build a base
[img]http://i.imgur.com/b4AVKKU.jpg[/img]

[b]Base Building, [/b]there's a machine that can turn your materials into Bricks, repair and keep it powered while you build your base
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uxwWMR8.jpg[/img]

Also plenty of new Event_Actions/Sprites/Items that made these Gauntlets possible.

Remember that [b]everything[/b] you see was made using the Editor. All the cool events like defending the Power Plant and repairing it or the Bomb or the Infected Death Counter were made exclusively using the Editor, there's no custom code behind it. What that means is with imagination you too can build something as complex and awesome as the new Gauntlets.

Cheers and enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #20
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9GGU7M5.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

This weeks update to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets[/b][/url] is a pretty important one, it adds the first of several epic Developer Gauntlets that I'm working on.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wvoVHU3.jpg[/img]
[b]Routine Scavenging,[/b] you got 5 days to craft your equipment to prepare for extraction. Things get quite hectic at night so make sure you get back to base before it gets too dark!
It is a very large Gauntlet with lots of content and as always I'm looking for feedback so let me know what you think of it including the difficulty.
Also make sure you use the Active Pause and Show Objects buttons for maximum efficiency.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iZS0KXE.jpg[/img]
Another awesome addition is [b]custom Interfaces![/b] You can now setup interactable menus to do anything you want, in the case of Routine Scavenging these Interfaces are used for leveling up your Survivors and crafting your Weapons.

I'm really excited to hear what you all think of the new Gauntlet, so far the biggest criticism of the game has been the lack of content so I hope the Gauntlets I'm building will help solve that.

And remember this was fully built using the Editor, so everything built in Routine Scavenging could be done by you! Just use your imagination and build something awesome!

Cheers and go play the new Gauntlet! Enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #19
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HbO84kr.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

This weeks update to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets[/b][/url] is a very visual one! New weapons, explosions and muzzle visuals!

[b]Valerie[/b], Grenade Launcher effective for area of effect damage at a distance
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tHWJeB6.gif[/img]

[b]Protheros[/b], Dual Pistols with a high rate of fire
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AFbFC4e.gif[/img]

[b]Fawkes[/b], Flamethrower light em up! Great for close quarters
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cVvTq1g.gif[/img]

[b]Dascomb[/b], Shotgun very effective at close range, fires multiple pellets that can kill multiple Infected
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bCnkN6Z.gif[/img]

[b]Delia[/b], Tesla Gun electrocutes Infected in close range and causes damage to other nearby Infected
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Bbd3Ppj.gif[/img]

[b]Etheridge[/b], Sniper rifle kills all Infected in a line from a long distance, takes a while to aim
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Mbue2Nh.gif[/img]


New Event Action, [b]Environment.Explosion[/b] let's you create explosions on the map, using an Event and a bunch of variables you can make a sort of Artillery attack for a defense Gauntlet.

The new Enter Exit Area Object allows for a lot of new possibilities using all the triggers it provides.

And also, Variables can now be used as Input on most of the Object Event Actions, so you could make a button that moves a wall to the side every time you press it or perhaps a create a complex puzzle maze with moveable Lasers.

Have fun!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720

notes.title: Survivor Squad: Gauntlets - Update #18
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sKsnhzG.jpg[/img]
Howdy folks!

This weeks [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331720][b]Survivor Squad: Gauntlets[/b][/url] update is a big one!
First of all, [b]Shooting while moving[/b] has been added!
It's one of the most requested features and you can now try it out. It is a very delicate mechanic so I look forward to hearing you feedback.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pjJnyFO.gif[/img]

[b]Event Triggers![/b]
Now Events have a separate tab for adding Event Triggers. Previously all Events were hardcoded with Proximity and Condition triggers, now you can add the ones you want including all the new triggers like Infected_Died and Item_Proximity.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PfuFkHC.gif[/img]

[b]Gauntlets Variables![/b]
It's very difficult to explain how important this is but it is massively important! There are various types of Variables and most Event Actions can take Variables as an Argument.
If you are a programmer like me you can probably start imagining all the possibilities but for everyone else let's just say the possible uses are endless.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CWtBw1v.gif[/img]

For example it is now possible to make a Gauntlet that works like an arena with RPG elements like leveling up or a shop. You can make it so that every dead Infected drops a certain resource, then using Item_Proximity you can make an Item drop area and increase a variable by that amount. Doing so you can get a "bank" of resources, then you could for example have a button that checks if you have enough resources to spawn a better Weapon or increase the Survivors View Distance.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lhJ0ABi.jpg[/img]

With enough imagination you could now [b]build an entire complex RPG within the game![/b] Stay tuned for some really cool Developer Gauntlets to be added in the coming weeks!

Enjoy!

Here's some Steam keys for Gauntlets for the first lucky few!

8ADK7-QV0RN-3RC5V

 * Added Cancel Move keybind
 * Fixed Bank Visual cleared/looted indicators bug
